help.title: How to use
help.body:
1. Engine: pick the engine build matching your game process (6115 / 6118), then Connect.
2. Refresh factions: read the campaign faction list (must be on the campaign map).
3. AI-ify (watch): hand the selected faction to the CAI; Restore reverts only factions changed in this session.
4. Battle injection: all-ai / auto / human / stop decides who commands a battle.
5. Watch filter: only load AI battles matching your strength / army-count thresholds.
6. Log: all diagnostics appear here (the packaged build has no console).
7. Language: switch zh/en from the top-right dropdown; takes effect after restart.
8. About: version / build time / MIT licence / repository.

Administrator rights are required: memory writes use OpenProcess / WriteProcessMemory.
ui.label.ba_note: (written on the pre-battle/campaign map, consumed at battle load; rewrite after restarting the game)
ui.label.dyn_base_split: Field base:{field_max} Siege base:{siege_max} Field floor:{field_floor} Siege floor:{siege_floor}
ui.label.split_note: (when checked, field/siege are filtered and baselined separately)
ui.label.whitelist_note: (multi-select / Ctrl / Shift + Mark Selected; empty whitelist = capture all)
ui.label.blacklist_note: (battles involving blacklisted factions are skipped; blacklist wins when both are set)
ui.label.minimap_note: (writes relation+0x7e0=1 for every faction; toggle the minimap tab once afterwards to rebuild)
dlg.admin.body:
This program is not running as administrator.

It needs to read and write the game process memory. Please close it and run it as Administrator.
(You can still browse the UI, but connecting to the game will fail.)
